root.label: Judge ordered release of Epstein apparent suicide note

events.label: Judge ordered release of Epstein apparent suicide note

slots.name: release date
slots.sentence: In May, a U.S. district judge ordered the release of an apparent suicide note from an incident less than a month before Epstein's death.

slots.name: filing date
slots.sentence: The note had been filed and sealed in May 2021 as part of a murder case involving Epstein's former cellmate, Nicholas Tartaglione.

slots.name: verification status
slots.sentence: CBS News has not independently verified the note.
